results.title: Adoption of IoT-based healthcare devices: An empirical study of end ...
results.content: This study identifies important factors that influence the adoption of IoT-based healthcare devices among end users and suggest a predictive model of adoption. The factors such as ubiquitous, social influence, perceived health risk, and relative advantage had a significant influence on attitude (ATT), which influences behavioral intention (BI) toward IoT-based healthcare devices. Also, the objective is to integrate the critical factors affecting the adoption of IoT-based healthcare devices by end consumers to provide a technology acceptance model (TAM) based on the popular UTAUT model [12] and the TAM [13].
